text: ZEturf is the online horse-race betting brand of the FDJ United group, which acquired the ZEturf group in 2023 for an enterprise value of 175 million euros; FDJ United is the former French state lottery, privatised in November 2019 when the state sold 52% and now retains a minority stake of about 20%.
short: ZEturf is the horse-betting brand of FDJ United; the French state holds about 20%.
